field_principles.acceptance_rows: Acceptance or state-change rates expose proposal behavior per unit.
field_principles.arm_rows: Arm summaries show which methods were eligible in each condition.
field_principles.asymptotic_scaling_claimed: False prevents bounded sizes from supporting a scaling inference.
field_principles.autocorrelation_rows: Complete frozen lag windows prevent favorable truncation after outcomes are known.
field_principles.budget_rows: Budget rows compare charged exact-energy evaluations with the frozen allowance.
field_principles.chain_rows: Chain traces retain status, samples, exact-energy costs, and correction facts per unit.
field_principles.condition_rows: Condition rows expose the full frustration and temperature design.
field_principles.duration_s: Monotonic elapsed time reports the complete host run without claiming speed portability.
field_principles.effective_sample_size_rows: Observable-level effective sample sizes report mixing within the fixed budget.
field_principles.energy_moment_rows: Energy means and variances expose distributional parity per unit.
field_principles.execution_venue: The host venue prevents an attached-hardware interpretation.
field_principles.failure_rows: Every failed or timed-out unit remains visible to reducers.
field_principles.field_principles: A reason for every required field makes the evidence contract auditable.
field_principles.finite_parity_verified: This flag passes only when each finite unit reports independent-law total variation.
field_principles.fixture_hashes: Condition hashes bind every size, coupling, field, and temperature.
field_principles.gate_check_summary: The summary retains the exact failed producer field and values, or a complete pass.
field_principles.hardware_execution_claimed: False records that no FPGA, TSU, or other hardware executed.
field_principles.honest_verdict: The text states the bounded outcome and agrees with the terminal class.
field_principles.inference_substrate: The declaration limits inference to the matched-budget CPU sampler benchmark.
field_principles.inference_substrate_class: The closed class separates CPU simulation from a blocked no-run result.
field_principles.matched_budget_verified: This flag passes only when every completed arm spends its exact declared budget.
field_principles.mode_occupancy_rows: Signed magnetization occupancy exposes mode traversal per unit.
field_principles.preconditions_checked: Measured gates stop all chains when a required producer or host resource fails.
field_principles.prototype_hash: The producer artifact hash binds this benchmark to the corrected Exp7133 result.
field_principles.random_seed: A fixed experiment seed binds deterministic stream separation and replay.
field_principles.reproducibility_checksum: The canonical digest detects any change to published evidence.
field_principles.rows: One summary row per seed, cell, and arm prevents aggregate-only claims.
field_principles.run_date: The fixed execution date identifies this evidence window.
field_principles.sampler_benchmark_complete_score: This binary score requires the full roster, budget, metrics, and claim checks.
field_principles.seed_rows: Seed summaries prove that no stochastic unit was pooled or removed.
field_principles.source_artifact_hashes: Hashes bind each prior artifact, implementation, verifier, and specification input.
field_principles.total_variation_rows: Finite cells compare empirical state mass with an independent exact law.
field_principles.verdict_class: The closed terminal class distinguishes a measured advantage, null, block, or failure.
field_principles.verifier_is_oracle: False records that the benchmark statistic is not used to generate sampler transitions.
field_principles.wall_time_rows: Host wall time is reported per unit without a hardware or scaling claim.

honest_verdict: complete: corrected multiscale sampling improves the preregistered bounded host ESS statistic
methodology: Each completed arm spends 1024 exact full-state energy evaluations. The plan was fixed before any chain outcome was read.

pooled_comparison.statistic: mean paired difference in minimum observable ESS
